## Discrete or continuous? {#l1-two-types }

::: {.split }
::: {.column-block}

<h3>Discrete</h3>

Separate, countable possible values.

- Number of customers: $0,1,2,\ldots$
- Winnings: $\$0$, $\$2.50$ or $\$10$

The values **need not be integers**.

:::

::: {.column-block}

<h3>Continuous</h3>

Any real value within an interval.

- A runner's finishing time
- The distance of a long jump

Usually a quantity obtained by **measurement**.

:::
:::


::: {.takeaway}
Ask what values the defined variable can take.
:::

::: notes
A discrete variable may have finitely or infinitely many values. Measurement precision and the underlying quantity must be distinguished.
:::
